description: Post the artist's own show, release party or listening party, or change one (pass event_id). Where: a city and a country, and/or an online link. Inviting artists or Audora stays the artist's to do in Audora; an edit keeps what they chose. Artist connections only.

artist.description: Only when you are connected as a label: the roster artist this call is for — their artist_user_id from list_roster, or their exact artist name. Required for every artist tool on a label connection. Leave it out on an artist's own connection.

country.description: The country's name as Audora's country list writes it (get_requirements has the list), e.g. Sweden.

ends_at.description: ISO date and time, or null.

is_public.description: Show it on the artist's public page.

line.description: One line about it, in the artist's words.

release_id.description: A party for one of the artist's releases (once it is out).

ticket_url.description: https link to tickets or info.

time_zone.description: IANA zone where it happens, e.g. Europe/Stockholm.

event_id.description: To change one; leave out to post a new one.

idempotency_key.description: Send the same key if you retry, and the change happens once.

name: save_event
title: Post or change a show or party
